question: Find the next set: AB, DE, GH, JK, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a6c1b703839665531bdb563757a69596253472c8767fec6930d8c04ec6c17a5.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: Take 2 consecutive letters, then skip 1 letter

AB → (A, B) → skip C

DE → (D, E) → skip F

GH → (G, H) → skip I

JK → (J, K) → skip L

⇒ After skipping L, next letters are M and N

Thus, the next set is MN.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
